reason: A web plugin for configuring token rates and calculating conversation costs from recorded usage, with totals and breakdowns shown in the interface.

summaries.zh: 配置提供方和模型的 token 价格，并根据会话中记录的用量计算和展示按轮次、按模型及总计费用。
summaries.en: Configure token rates by provider and model, then calculate and display per-turn, per-model, and total conversation costs from recorded usage.

capabilities: Configures per-provider and per-model token pricing
Derives token usage and cost data from persisted conversation logs
Calculates and displays per-turn, per-model, and total conversation costs
Persists derived usage data with sessions and archives
